manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} on the first turn, with at most {6}{U}{U}{U} available each other extra turn
notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature with power two or greater.
You have not cast an instant or sorcery this turn.
description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U} and sacrificing a creaature with power two or greater.
Temporal Manipulation's casualty ability and Poppet Stitcher trigger.
Resolve the Temporal Manipulation trigger, copying it.
Resolve the Poppet Stitcher trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve both Temporal Manipulations, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your last extra turn.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing a Zombie, targeting Mystic Retrieval.
Call to Mind's casualty ability and Poppet Stitcher trigger.
Resolve the Call to Mind trigger, copying it, targeting Temporal Manipulation.
Resolve the Poppet Stitcher trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve both Call to Minds, returning Temporal Manipulation and Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {3}{U} and sacrificing a Zombie, targeting Call to Mind.
Mystic Retrieval's casualty ability and Poppet Stitcher trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Retrieval trigger, copying it, targeting Temporal Manipulation.
Resolve the Poppet Stitcher trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve both Mystic Retrievals, returning Temporal Manipulation and Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Repeat from step 7.
